student_support.sql:
SELECT support_tickets.id, support_tickets.organization_id, support_tickets.student_id, support_tickets.student_name, support_tickets.student_email, support_tickets.subject, support_tickets.category, support_tickets.status, support_tickets.resolved_at, support_tickets.resolved_by_member_id, support_tickets.created_at, support_tickets.updated_at 
FROM support_tickets 
WHERE support_tickets.student_id = 'd6d77053-92bc-7af6-3332-8bea8c4c6904' ORDER BY support_tickets.updated_at DESC

studio_collected_payments.sql:
SELECT sum(payments.amount) AS sum_1 
FROM payments JOIN orders ON payments.order_id = orders.id 
WHERE orders.organization_id = '71f82408-0503-1caf-aec6-98e6445b893a' AND orders.currency = 'INR' AND orders.status = 'PAID' AND payments.status = 'SUCCESS' AND payments.currency = 'INR'

due_meeting_email_batch.sql:
SELECT meeting_email_deliveries.id 
FROM meeting_email_deliveries 
WHERE meeting_email_deliveries.status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY') AND meeting_email_deliveries.available_at <= '2026-10-27 18:58:57.161882+05:30' ORDER BY meeting_email_deliveries.available_at 
 LIMIT 100
